comment: The pipeline model: each workflow this repository owns, as data, one file per workflow at app/specs/pipeline/workflows/<name>.json, rendered to .github/workflows/<name> by the pipeline generator (generators/pipeline, a LexLean program) through tools/generators/run.sh; run.sh --check (GN-01) fails on a rendered file that differs. generators/pipeline/steps.json has one step per workflow. In any mapping, "#" gives the comment lines above each key, and "" the comment above a list item. The template's own workflows (template.lock) are not here.
